ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels; white pigmentation is concentrated on the lateral lobes while black pigmentation is dominant in the central region and along the trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, contiguous high-intensity white zones located on the distal half of both the left and right lobes; these are bounded by a thick low-intensity black border at the trailing edge and a central black region extending from the peduncle to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 42 degrees; the notch depth occupies roughly 18% of the visible vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular micro-serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 8 pixels; prominent jagged peaks are visible along the entire superior boundary of both lobes, contrasted against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edge transitioning to a sharp convex curve at the lateral tips; the overall 2D projection forms a wide, symmetrical 'W' configuration.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, textured circular pixel formations (barnacle colonizations) are visible on the extreme distal tips of both lobes; appearing as off-white protrusions against the black terminal edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant detection of dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions; specifically, 4 parallel diagonal rake marks on the left white field and multiple intersecting vertical scratches on the right white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple parallel linear rake marks (likely odontocete-related) cutting through the white ventral pigmentation; irregular tissue loss and notched peaks along the trailing edge indicative of historical abrasive impact.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'comma-shaped' black pigment intrusion into the high-intensity white field of the left lobe's upper quadrant.
